description: Evaluate a PromQL query in a range of time

inputSchema.description: QueryRangeRequest holds all parameters of the Prometheus upstream range query API plus GCM specific parameters.

end.description: The end time to evaluate the query for. Either floating point UNIX seconds or RFC3339 formatted timestamp.

location.description: Location of the resource information. Has to be "global" now.

name.description: Required. The project on which to execute the request. Data associcated with the project's workspace stored under the The format is: projects/[PROJECT_ID_OR_NUMBER]. Open source API but used as a request path prefix to distinguish different virtual Prometheus instances of Google Prometheus Engine.

query.description: A PromQL query string. Query language documentation: https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/basics/.

start.description: The start time to evaluate the query for. Either floating point UNIX seconds or RFC3339 formatted timestamp.

step.description: The resolution of query result. Either a Prometheus duration string (https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/basics/#time-durations) or floating point seconds. This non-standard encoding must be used for compatibility with the open source API. Clients may still implement timeouts at the connection level while ignoring this field.

timeout.description: An upper bound timeout for the query. Either a Prometheus duration string (https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/basics/#time-durations) or floating point seconds. This non-standard encoding must be used for compatibility with the open source API. Clients may still implement timeouts at the connection level while ignoring this field.

name: query_range

data.description: The Prometheus API response payload. Typically present when status is 'success'.

error.description: The error message. Present when status is 'error'.

errorType.description: The type of error (e.g., 'bad_data', 'timeout'). Present when status is 'error'.

status.description: Indicates if the API call was successful or resulted in an error.

warnings.description: A list of warnings that occurred while processing the request.
